8. Arrange the following fuels in the descending order of the ignition temperature.
(A) Charcoal (B) Petroleum gas
(C) Natural gas (D) Gasoline
(a) DBCA (b) ADBC (c) CDBA (d) DCBA

9. Arrange the following reactants associated with methane in the order of
their categories given below.
(Substitution reaction, combustion reaction, cracking and manufacture)
(A) Heating of $\mathrm{CH}_4$ in absence of air.
(B) Reaction between $\mathrm{CH}_4$ and $\mathrm{Cl}_2$ in the presence of sunlight.
(C) Heating anhydrous sodium acetate with soda lime.
(D) Reaction between $\mathrm{CH}_4$ and $\mathrm{O}_2$.
(a) CDBA (b) ACBD (c) BDAC (d) BDCA

10. The nature of the product which is not a gas obtained during hydrolysis of
calcium carbide is ______.
(a) basic (b) strongly acidic
(c) neutral (d) weakly acidic

11. Thermal decomposition of sodium bicarbonate is associated with ______.
(a) dry powder fire extinguisher
(b) liquid $\text{CO}_2$ fire extinguisher
(c) soda-acid fire extinguisher
(d) foam-type of fire extinguisher

12. Passing excess $\mathrm{CO}_2$ through milky lime water makes it clear due to the for-
mation of ______.
(a) $\mathrm{CaCO}_3$ (b) $\mathrm{Na_2CO}_3$
(c) $\mathrm{NaHCO}_3$ (d) $\mathrm{Ca}(\mathrm{HCO}_3)_2$

13. Which of the following types of coal, on destructive distillation, gives rise to
the minimum yield of coke?
(a) Peat (b) Bituminous
(c) Lignite (d) Anthracite

14. Identify the process of releasing $\mathrm{CO}_2$ in the atmosphere.
(a) Dissolution of $\mathrm{CO}_2$ in water bodies
(b) Formation of fossil fuel from dead remains
(c) Respiration
(d) Afforestation
